assignment.narration: At eleven thousand meters down, sunlight vanishes completely within the first thousand. The water pressure reaches nearly eleven hundred atmospheres—the crushing equivalent of fifty jumbo jets stacked on top of you.

parsed.intent: A single descent through the Mariana Trench: sunlight disappears at 1,000 meters, then the depth and pressure culminate in a visual comparison to fifty jumbo jets per square centimeter.

The submersible reaches the trench floor and the maximum-depth figure resolves to 10,994 meters; a pressure dial climbs toward 1,086 atmospheres.
The final pressure reading locks in, and a row of jet symbols completes the comparison: 50 jumbo jets pressing on each square centimeter.

persistentElements: Vertical trench depth scale with the 1,000-meter sunlight threshold

assignment.heading: The 1.7-Mile Chokepoint
assignment.topic: Why 84,000 Ships Risk the Strait of Malacca
assignment.narration: Over eighty-four thousand ships cram through this narrow waterway every year, carrying a quarter of the world's traded oil. At its tightest choke point, the navigable channel narrows to just one point seven miles wide.

handoff.opening: Dark ocean map with faint strait silhouette and gold title line
persistentElements: Strait map with amber shipping lane
handoff.endState: Radar-locked gold chokepoint ring with caliper spanning 1.7 MI and steady counters

parsed.intent: A top-down schematic map of the Strait of Malacca highlights the massive volume and value of ship traffic against the severe geographical constraint of its narrowest chokepoint.

beats.action: Grid and title fade in. Abstract landmasses of the Malay Peninsula and Sumatra draw into view, establishing the waterway. The '84,000 Ships' metric springs onto the HUD as glowing amber traffic routes begin flowing through the strait.

The narrative shifts to cargo value. The '25% Global Oil' and '$3.5 Trillion' metric cards spring into the periphery. The flowing traffic lines pulse with increased opacity to emphasize the immense economic weight passing through.

Focus snaps to the geographical constraint. Red warning brackets lock onto the narrowest gap between the landmasses. A bold '1.7 MILES' label springs into the center of the chokepoint, visually contrasting the massive traffic volume with the tiny navigable channel.

handoff.opening: Dark ocean background with a subtle technical grid fading in, followed by the main title.
handoff.endState: All metrics visible, traffic flowing continuously, with the central chokepoint heavily emphasized by red warning brackets and the '1.7 MILES' label.
